newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel diffs move sideways in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel diffs move sideways in thin trade.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel differentials showed little movement in the lackluster trading conditions Friday as many participants got an early start on the weekend.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures were up 0.16 cent at 56.35 cents a gallon.
Prompt 54-grade jet fuel in the U.S. Gulf was seen between about 0.50 and 0.60 cent over the September futures, the top end of Thursday's trading range.
But the any-month 54-grade barrels changed hands at 0.50 cents over the NYMEX, pushing offers to 0.60 to 0.65 cent over by mid-afternoon.
